question:
**Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Partial
solution:
The correct answer is: **Whole.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**partial**" means** incomplete, limited, or not whole.** It suggests that something is only a part or portion of the whole. Therefore, the opposite of "partial" would be "whole," which means complete or entire.(आंशिक)
 
• Example:
 
 
• Let's say you are given a puzzle to solve, and you have completed only a portion of it. You could say, "I have made **partial **progress on the puzzle."
 
• In this example, "**partial**" indicates that you have only completed a part of the puzzle, while "whole" would represent completing the entire puzzle.
 
 
 
• Among the given options, **3) Whole **is the correct choice as it presents the opposite meaning to "**partial**," representing** something complete or entire.**
 
 
• Example**: **I read the **whole **book in one sitting because I couldn't put it down.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's analyze the other options:
 
• **Truce**: The word "truce" refers to a temporary pause or cessation of hostilities, usually in the context of a conflict or disagreement. (युद्धविराम संधि)It is not the opposite of "partial."
 
• **Sufficient**: The word "sufficient" means enough or adequate.(पर्याप्त) It does not have an opposite meaning to "partial."
 
• **Broke**: The word "broke" refers to having no money or being financially destitute.(टूट गया) It is not the opposite of "partial."
